name: Upsampling Layer
definition: A layer that expands the spatial dimensions x and y of an input volume U of size x × y × p by factors sx and sy respectively to generate a volume V of size (sx x) × (sy y) × p. Contains no trainable parameters. Used in the decoder to reconstruct original size.
summary: The Upsampling Layer is a parameter-free operation that expands spatial dimensions by copying input values and filling gaps with zeros, distinguishing itself from interpolation methods by using explicit scaling ratios without trainable weights.
